en: What on earth are you thinking?

You know full well you shouldn't bother
with me... So why're you still here?

<CLT=cltMIND>I've been told not to get involved
countless times before. But...

I don't intend on throwing our relationship
away, Ryoma. And I won't let you, either.

You knew the consequences but stuck to
your feelings anyway. I respect that.

I don't want someone I respect to tell
me that they have nothing.

That's why I want to stay by your side...
as your classmate, and your friend.
...Ryoma?

Geez...so this is what it's like to 
be at a loss for words.
You're a bigger idiot than me.
But...I don't dislike that about you.
Ryoma...

Shuichi, you got a minute? Let's go 
to my research lab.
First, go ahead and take these.
<CLT=cltMIND>A tennis ball and racquet?

I don't know if you've played tennis 
before, but you can hit the ball, right?
Ah, I think I can...

Then I'm going to check your resolve.
Ready? Aim for me with the ball.
Aim for you?

Try hitting me with it.
Right in the face, if you can.

You want me to do *what*!?
Hit you...? Are you serious?
I can't do that!
I would be no match for you...
Alright, I'll do it
Are you unsure of something?

I said I was going to test your 
resolve, right? So show me.

I can't do that!
It's dangerous!

You can't become that big of an idiot?
Well too bad.
Come on. Join me in my stupidity.

This is the only way I can 
test your resolve.

...Alright, I suppose...
If this is what you want, Ryoma...
I would be no match for you...

Huh? I'm not saying we should 
have a match.

I want to see your resolve. This is a 
test of feelings, not skill.

I'll say it one more time.
Shuichi, serve the ball right at me!
O-Okay!
Alright, I'll do it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know what he's thinking,
but if this is what he wants...

Hmph, good answer. I knew you were
that kind of idiot.
Now, let's get stupid.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma stood on the other side of the net,
tennis racquet gripped lightly in his hand.

<CLT=cltMIND>Imitating the pros to the best of my
ability, I threw the ball up and swung...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*pang*!

<CLT=cltMIND>My racquet connected, and the ball flew
toward Ryoma faster than I expected.
Guh!
Ryoma!?

That was a good serve.
I could feel how serious you are.
But you've still got a ways to go!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*whap*!
What!?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*zoom*!

<CLT=cltMIND>I stood frozen in fear. The ball grazed by
my cheek so close I could feel the fibers.

W-W-Wait a minute!
You're gonna hit it *back* at me!?

I never said I wouldn't. Don't worry. 
I won't hit any vital parts.

<CLT=cltMIND>He's got his game face on!
What am I supposed to do!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Our fierce battle began...

<CLT=cltMIND>Over the course of the match, I realized
why Ryoma would test me like this.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Because that's just
Ryoma's way.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because during that game, we were both
having fun, goofing off, messing around...
<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know how much time passed.

<CLT=cltMIND>After every drop of our energy was spent,
we both collapsed on the court, panting.

Hey, Shuichi... Even if we get out of 
here, I'll still be in prison, but...

If I ever get out...I'm going to go 
and pick up everything I threw away.

It's too late for a lot of things, 
but if I can still reach some...
I'd like to bear those stains again.

Just like how I'm bearing you 
on my back right now.
...Yeah.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma hasn't lost his
passion for tennis.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm so glad that I could help
him face that side of himself...

<CLT=cltMIND>That's what this was
all about, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I helped him find the fun of the game
again, because of our bond as friends.

<CLT=cltMIND>As long as we have that bond,
no opponent will ever beat us.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Ryoma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You have learned a new skill, <CLT=cltSTRONG>Killer Smash<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma and I spent what felt like hours on that
court, laughing and talking about nothing...
